notes.title: The update is already here!
notes.notes:
Now there is no default timer in Machi! We understand that every player has their own unique game strategy, so you can now choose whether to turn on the timer or play in relaxed mode. Solve puzzles in your own way!


 We've also added Multichoice. It will make your game much easier by giving you options to fill each cell. Now you can see the possible choices and choose the most suitable one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193644/0e124b6543a0dc4c6ea93daebeb311c6bf15f212.gif

 Multichoice Picker feature. Incorrect move choices will now be highlighted in red.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193644/8d27842a42a9cc4d219c3fa200b00d7ba3a1edca.gif

We redesigned the algorithms for solving puzzles, now each puzzle will have only one version of its solution.

 We've also changed the difficulty system in MACHI. The level of difficulty will now depend on the number of hints provided in advance. The fewer hints you use, the more difficult the puzzle becomes. 

 We've also fixed some bugs we found at certain levels. We are pleased to announce that we have released a hotfix and the levels are now displayed correctly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, and thank you for your patience.
